issues.title: Premature description truncation
issues.description: The error description truncates with ellipsis despite remaining container width.
issues.evidence: Text shows 'Upload failed · over 10 MB ...' before reaching the card edge.
issues.suggestion: Allow description container to expand across available horizontal space.
issues.triageNote: Verified real: AttachmentActions reserved in-flow width (52px + gap) while opacity-0, so AttachmentDescription truncated at 170px despite needing 181px and 62px of visibly empty card space; fixed by overlaying horizontal actions on the row end with a background scrim instead of reserving flex space.
